text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races
alongside Vodka—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Time's up, Trainer!
Vodka suddenly stepped right in front of me and blurted out a bizarre statement.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, don't tell me you forgot
about those tickets, did you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At the start of the Senior Year,
about that grand prize she won in the lottery—
choice_data_list: Tickets for a hot spring trip!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's the one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I wanted to go on
a motorcycle touring trip..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I figured you might have a bike by the time the Twinkle Series settles down, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
However, I still don't have a motorcycle!
Even so, I can't just take my sweet time anymore.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Because time's up, after all.
choice_data_list: So, what's that time limit you mentioned?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's the ticket's expiration date!
If I don't use it, it's just gonna turn into scrap paper~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, we can't afford to be picky.
Let's go touring—by train!
(—*clack-clack, clack-clack*)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hyahaa! Let's kick it into high gearrr!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Hyahaa. Thanks for speeding along,
Mr. Driver..."
Whispering in hushed voices, we made our way to the hot spring inn.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was the best bath ever, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's like the heat just blasts right into your bones!
Warms you right up, body and soul!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, I'll be barging
into your room after this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Today, we gotta talk all about our memories tearing up the mountain passes!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, I don't remember any of that happening!

There's no way.
Because I came by train.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Who would've thought we'd go to a hot spring
while rattling along and munching on kaki-pi?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, this is just a neighborhood association trip.
And here I wanted to ride tandem with Trainer and aggressively tear through the corners.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Guess we've got no choice,
so how 'bout we talk about our memories so far!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Our countless legends!

Picking at the sashimi and hot pot brought to the table,
Vodka continued chatting in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! During that Derby,
I was seriously torn!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't given me that stylish advice,
I might have given up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And before that Fan Appreciation Day, too!
You told me on the roof to
"keep going just as you are"!
choice_data_list: Did I say something like that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you really forget!? That's a cruel joke.
Back then, I was genuinely moved.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because that happened, I...
I...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuuu...

Vodka suddenly choked on her words,
and began to sob.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Talkin' like this made me... think.
Or rather, I just realized something, man...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We've... been touring together this whole time, haven't we?
Without even realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right. Even without a bike,
you were always right there running with me."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And whenever I took a wrong turn or was about
to hit the brakes, they always told me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "‘Charge straight ahead! Don't lose your nerve!’ That's the spirit."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If it was just me alone, I might've tripped up.
I might've even retired midway through..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And yet, because you were there!
Thanks to you...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even without attacking mountain passes...
we've got so much to talk about, don't we? So very, very much...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is so gloomy and uncool! Tonight,
I was planning on having a hearty laugh until I rolled on the floor...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can't hold back what's welling up inside me.
Damn it all!

She was likely a tenderhearted person by nature. Being alone at the hot spring inn,
she seemed unable to keep up her tough front any longer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer.
Thanks, partner.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, screw it, just laugh all you want
at pathetic old me today!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally boiled and mushy from the hot spring!
Don't you dare tell anyone, jeez!

With her raw emotions laid bare,
Vodka spent the rest of that night laughing through her tears.

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Vodka...
